items.title: Claude Skills Getting Started
items.summary: Claude Skills allow us to extend Claude's capabilities by creating reusable instructions, reference materials, and scripts that Claude can automatically discover and use when relevant. Instead of repeatedly providing the same instructions, we can package them into skills that help Claude perform specific tasks more consistently and efficiently.This presentation provides a practical introduction to Claude Skills, from understanding the fundamental concepts to creating, testing, refining, and optimizing custom skills.We explore the differences between Claude Account Skills, Claude Code Personal Skills, and Claude Code Project Skills, and examine how skills are structured using SKILL.md files, frontmatter, reference materials, and executable scripts.In a step-by-step demonstration, we create a skill that produces a monthly Java newsletter, customize its behavior, activate it, and review the results.The presentation also covers:Effective Skill Design: Defining clear purposes, constraints, instructions, and expected output formats.Skill Testing: Validating activation behavior, testing different scenarios, and improving reliability through iterative refinement.Practical Applications: Using skills in software development, education, business, and research.Design Patterns: Understanding template-based and workflow-based skills.Optimization Techniques: Reduce unnecessary context, organize supporting materials, and add validation to skill workflows.Best Practices: Keep skills focused, write actionable instructions, and continuously improve their behavior.The central message is that Claude Skills transform repetitive instructions into reusable capabilities, enabling more structured, reliable, and productive AI-assisted workflows.The presentation suits developers, educators, business professionals, and anyone who wants to use Claude better. No programming background is required.Haim MichaelFounder & CEO, Zindell Technologieshttps://blog.lifemichael.comPost:https://lifemichael.com/en/exploring-claude-skills-in-our-latest-online-meetup/Video:https://youtu.be/YP81rkrpgpE
